import { mapLimit } from "./concurrency.js";
// CASE js_array_destructure_write expect=pass
export async function w1(items, op, parse, config) {
  let width = 1;
  [width] = parse(config);
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}
// CASE js_object_destructure_plain expect=pass
export async function w2(items, op, config) {
  let width = 1;
  ({ width } = config);
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}
// CASE js_then_callback_write expect=pass
export async function w3(items, op, loadConfig) {
  let width = 1;
  await loadConfig().then((config) => {
    width = config.width;
  });
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}
// CASE js_increment expect=pass
export async function w4(items, op, fast) {
  let width = 1;
  if (fast) width++;
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}
// CASE js_logical_and_assign expect=pass
export async function w5(items, op, config) {
  let width = 1;
  width &&= config.width;
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}
// CASE js_options_destructure_write expect=pass
export async function w6(items, op, config) {
  let concurrency = 1;
  ({ concurrency } = config);
  await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency });
}
// CASE js_for_of_write expect=pass
export async function w7(items, op, widths) {
  let width = 1;
  for (width of widths) {
    if (width > 4) break;
  }
  await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}
// CASE js_end expect=pass
